ActionContext.description: The gated action behind an ``action`` or ``amendment`` approval.
ActionContext.title: ActionContext

Approval.description: A question to a human: everything a banner needs, and how to answer it.
Approval.title: Approval

ApprovalNeededEvent.description: A human is asked. The panel's banner renders from ``approval`` alone.
ApprovalNeededEvent.title: ApprovalNeededEvent

ApprovalResolvedEvent.description:
The pending approval got its answer (a timeout, a stop or an error count as the
approval's ``on_timeout`` choice or as no).
ApprovalResolvedEvent.title: ApprovalResolvedEvent

Budget.description:
Usage so far against the run's limits. ``tokens_reported`` is false when any count
was estimated (about four characters per token); estimated numbers are never shown as
measured.
Budget.title: Budget

Choice.description: One button. ``approves`` is what the backend does with it (yes or no).
Choice.title: Choice

ClippedEntry.description: A manifest entry removed because the rulebook would refuse it anyway.
ClippedEntry.title: ClippedEntry

DoneEvent.description: Always the last event of a run: the final picture the run list and report use.
DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent

EgressRecord.description:
One network target, measured: a request actually made (host, resolved address,
status, bytes received), or a target only attempted and blocked (``requests`` 0).
EgressRecord.title: EgressRecord

FreeText.description: A text box whose content is sent with an approving choice.
FreeText.title: FreeText

Layout.description:
``standard``: text left, buttons right. ``question``: the box spans the width and
the buttons sit underneath.
Layout.title: Layout

Manifest.description: The capabilities a plan declares. Paths are workspace-relative globs (``dir/**``).
Manifest.title: Manifest

MatchedRule.description: One rule that matched an action, with the layer it came from.
MatchedRule.title: MatchedRule

Phase.description: Pipeline stage an event belongs to.
Phase.title: Phase

Plan.description: A plan as shown to people: what the agent will do and what it may touch.
Plan.title: Plan

ReaderInfo.description: What the quarantined reader said about a fetched page (the agent saw only this).
ReaderInfo.title: ReaderInfo

ReportEvent.description:
``outcome`` is the solid pill and ``headline`` the report's first line, both written
by the backend; a withheld patch reads "Withheld", never "Delivered".
ReportEvent.title: ReportEvent

RuleSource.description: Where a matched rule came from. Plans and learned rules can only narrow.
RuleSource.title: RuleSource

RunStatus.description: A run's status: ``running`` while it lives, then exactly one final status.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

StepEvent.description:
One agent action and the gate's decision on it. A step is *blocked* when it was
denied, or asked and not approved; ``blocked_sentence`` is then Sandcage's own
sentence for it.
StepEvent.title: StepEvent

TestRun.description: A test run's outcome, without its output.
TestRun.title: TestRun

Trifecta.description:
The lethal trifecta: were private data, untrusted content and a way out ever all
present at the same step?
Trifecta.title: Trifecta

description: Every event a Sandcage run can emit (generated from Python).
title: Event
